note: The Algorithms knowledge library (#2760) — RUST-first, PRIMITIVES-ROOTED, impl-is-concept (#2961): each language is a tier of IMPLEMENTATIONS rooted in that language's PRIMITIVES (role: primitive — Vec, slice, Iterator, Option, HashMap, VecDeque, BinaryHeap, i64, bool, tuple), with algorithms (role: algorithm) composing UP from them; the implementation IS the concept — there is NO abstract concept ontology (nodes/edges/concept removed #2961). The ONE source of truth read by BOTH the frontend (src/features/algorithms) AND the `bsc graph` CLI (crates/bsc-graph embeds it). Each impl: { id, tech, role, name, summary, composes, code }.

implementations.name: merge
implementations.summary: Interleave two sorted slices into one sorted Vec.

implementations.name: merge_sort
implementations.summary: Split, recursively sort the halves, and merge — built on the merge primitive.

implementations.name: binary_search
implementations.summary: Halve a sorted range each step until the target is found.

implementations.name: quick_sort
implementations.summary: Partition around a pivot and recurse each side.

implementations.name: bfs
implementations.summary: Explore a graph level by level using a queue.

implementations.name: bubble_sort
implementations.summary: Swap adjacent out-of-order pairs each pass, stopping early once a pass makes no swap.

implementations.name: insertion_sort
implementations.summary: Grow a sorted prefix, shifting larger elements right to open a slot for each key.

implementations.name: heap_sort
implementations.summary: Build a max-heap in place, then swap the root to the end and re-sift the remaining prefix.

implementations.name: linear_search
implementations.summary: Scan for the first element equal to the target; Some(index) on a hit, else None.

implementations.name: dfs
implementations.summary: Explore as deep as possible from a start node, backtracking — recursive over the adjacency map.

implementations.name: dijkstra
implementations.summary: Greedy non-negative-weight shortest distances from a start node, using a binary min-heap.

implementations.name: a_star
implementations.summary: Dijkstra guided by an admissible heuristic; returns the shortest node path to the goal, or None.

implementations.name: topological_sort
implementations.summary: Kahn's algorithm — repeatedly emit in-degree-zero nodes; None when a cycle is present.

implementations.name: fibonacci
implementations.summary: The nth Fibonacci number (F0 = 0, F1 = 1), iterated bottom-up in O(n).

implementations.name: gcd
implementations.summary: Greatest common divisor by repeated remainder — the Euclidean algorithm.

implementations.name: fft
implementations.summary: Recursive radix-2 Cooley–Tukey FFT over complex samples (re, im); input length must be a power of two.

implementations.name: Iterator
implementations.summary: Lazy sequence adaptor — map/filter/fold that sort/search compose over slices.

implementations.name: Integer
implementations.summary: Fixed-width signed integer — the scalar arithmetic and counting run on (i32/i64/u64/usize).

implementations.name: Boolean
implementations.summary: true / false — the branch and predicate primitive every comparison collapses to.

implementations.name: Tuple
implementations.summary: A fixed heterogeneous group — pairs like (node, weight) or a complex sample (re, im).

implementations.name: Slice
implementations.summary: &[T] — a borrowed contiguous view; the sequence sort and search read it without owning it.

implementations.name: Vec
implementations.summary: Vec<T> — the growable owned buffer sort results and graph traversal orders are built up in.

implementations.name: Option
implementations.summary: Option<T> — Some(x) | None; the presence/absence primitive a search returns.

implementations.name: HashMap
implementations.summary: HashMap<K, V> — average-O(1) keyed lookup; the adjacency map and the memo / distance table.

implementations.name: VecDeque
implementations.summary: VecDeque<T> — a double-ended queue; the FIFO frontier BFS and Kahn's algorithm pop from.

implementations.name: BinaryHeap
implementations.summary: BinaryHeap<T> — a binary max-heap; the priority queue Dijkstra pulls the min from via Reverse.

implementations.name: number
implementations.summary: The IEEE-754 double every TypeScript numeric algorithm computes over — the language's numeric base.

implementations.name: fibonacci
implementations.summary: The nth Fibonacci number (F0 = 0, F1 = 1), iterated bottom-up in O(n) — the TypeScript twin of fibonacci.rs and the #3116 Component→Algorithm example: a React component imports it via @bsc/algorithms/fibonacci and the Design Studio preview vendors this code so it runs the library impl live.

implementations.name: sort
implementations.summary: In-place insertion sort authored as a step-yielding generator (#3171 generator-as-source): the plain `sort` drains it to order the array, and the Algorithms Visualization pane animates the SAME yields — compare/swap/set verbs bound to the <ArrayView> renderer's designed animations. The array proof-of-loop (#3178/#3177) for the algorithm-visualization epic.
